# Smith-Midland to Present and Host at August 2026 Midwest IDEAS Conference


*August 21, 2026* |[Investor Relations / Financials](https://smithmidland.com/blog/category/investor-relations/) ,[Smith-Midland Corporation](https://smithmidland.com/blog/category/smith-midland-corporation/)


MIDLAND, VA – August 21, 2026 – Smith-Midland Corporation (NASDAQ: SMID) a provider of innovative, high-quality proprietary and patented precast concrete products and systems, today announced that Ashley B. Smith, President and CEO and Dominic L. Hunter, Chief Financial Officer will attend and host investor meetings at the Midwest IDEAS Investor Conference on Thursday, August 27, 2026, at The InterContinental in Chicago, IL. Smith-Midland’s presentation is scheduled to begin at 11:15 am CT. The company’s presentation will be webcast and may be accessed through the conference host’s main website:[https://www.threepartadvisors.com/midwest](https://www.threepartadvisors.com/midwest) .


Qualified investors that would like to attend the conference or schedule a meeting with management please contact Lacey Wesley at (817) 769 -2373 or[lWesley@IDEASconferences.com](https://smithmidland.com/blog/2025/08/25/smith-midland-to-present-host-at-midwest-ideas-investor-conference/lWesley@IDEASconferences.com) .


****


**About Smith-Midland Corporation**


[Smith-Midland](http://www.smithmidland.com/) develops, manufactures, licenses, rents, and sells a broad array of precast concrete products and systems for use primarily in the construction, transportation, and utility industries.


Smith-Midland Corporation has three manufacturing facilities in; Midland, VA, Reidsville, NC, and Columbia, SC, and a J-J Hooks® Safety Barrier rental firm,[Concrete Safety Systems](http://www.css-rental.com/) . Easi-Set Worldwide, a wholly owned subsidiary of Smith-Midland Corporation, licenses the production and sale of Easi-Set products, including J-J Hooks and SlenderWall®, and provides diversification opportunities to the precast industry worldwide. For more information, please call (540) 439-3266 or visit[www.smithmidland.com](http://www.smithmidland.com/) .
